source_envelope: references/TransitionMPW1_summary_Coder_NAS2021.pdf, page 22 (Case 2B - Alpha Sweep), embedded 1000x750 raster panels xref 543 (xtr_u vs Alpha) and 545 (xtr_l vs Alpha); NLF(1)-0416, M=0.1, Re=4e6 workshop Case 2B, ~14 participant submittals as colored letter-marker curves, experiment = filled black circles
source_piotrowski: references/PiotrowskiZingg2020_SA-gamma-smooth_NLF0416.pdf, page 22, Fig. 6(f) Transition locations: vector paths; blue dash-dot = SA-LM2015 (fine grid), red solid = SA-sLM2015 (fine grid), gray open squares = LTPT experiment (series identified by legend-row alignment of vector colors)
axes_note: Workshop envelope: abscissa = alpha [deg], ordinate = xtr/c (panels are xtr_u vs Alpha and xtr_l vs Alpha; NOT cl-based). Piotrowski Fig 6(f): ordinate = Cl, abscissa = transition location x/c; kept as cl (NOT converted to alpha). Piotrowski sweep points correspond to alpha = -6..6 deg step 2 on the fine grid (cl(alpha=0)=0.497 digitized vs 0.488 in their grid-convergence panel).

upper.note: only circles not occluded by participant symbols

lower.note: only circles not occluded by participant symbols

notes: Workshop calibration: x-axis major ticks (inward, 13px) at pixel cols 184,306,429,551,674,796,918 -> alpha=-4..8 step 2 (61.17 px/deg); y-axis major ticks at rows 84,199.5,314.5,429,545 -> xtr=1.0..0.2 step 0.2 (576.2 px/unit); bottom axis row 659 maps to xtr=0.0015, i.e. calibration self-consistent to ~0.002. Envelope = per-column min/max over saturated (non-black, non-white) pixels in the plot interior, sampled in +/-3 px windows at integer alpha; both panels share identical geometry. Participant curves are drawn as colored letter glyphs (~20 px tall) centered on the data points and connected by thin lines, so the envelope includes glyph extent: inflate/deflate uncertainty ~ +/-0.017 in xtr/c. No legend box inside either plot area (nothing masked); ~14 distinct letter/color codes visible (c,d,e,f,g,h,i,j,k,m,q,r,u,...). Experiment (black filled circles, r~9-10 px) recovered by disc template matching on dark pixels; only unoccluded circles are recoverable - upper surface alpha ~ -3,-1,+1; lower surface alpha ~ 0,1,3,7; the remaining experiment symbols are buried under the letter clusters. A near-black thin participant curve exists in the cm panel but no all-black participant line was detected inside the xtr panels (dark-thin-line mask empty), so the colored-pixel envelope should not be missing a black submittal. Piotrowski calibration from tick-label centers of panel (f): x/c: px=350.1+141.875*x; Cl: py=565.35-51.8*Cl; model curves taken from the 7-vertex vector polylines (marker fills coincide); legend samples excluded; LTPT experiment squares (n=41) split upper/lower by nearest-model-curve classification. Caveat: workshop envelope min/max is over ALL submittals including gross outliers (e.g. the green "m" participant near xtr~0.02-0.1 on both surfaces and cyan "h" collapsing to ~0 at high alpha); the headline scatter is real, not a digitization artifact. Piotrowski experiment upper/lower split is ambiguous only near the branch crossing (cl~0.2-0.5, x/c~0.4-0.5) where the two branches nearly coincide. Piotrowski color-to-series mapping verified against legend row positions: blue dash-dot polylines = SA-LM2015fine, red solid = SA-sLM2015fine.
